description: This Java class implements the HL7DAO interface for database operations related to HL7 message processing in the OpenMRS system using Hibernate ORM. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and querying HL7 message sources, queues, archives, and errors, including batch retrieval and specific criteria-based searches.

classes.name: HibernateHL7DAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of HL7DAO interface for managing HL7 message data in the database within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory for database interaction.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7Source entity in the database.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Retrieves all HL7Source entities from the database.

methods.name: deleteHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes a specified HL7Source.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7InQueue entity.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Retrieves all HL7InQueue entries with messageStatus pending.

methods.name: getHL7Batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7 entities based on class, start, length, messageStatus, and query string.

methods.name: countHL7s
methods.description: Counts HL7 entities matching specified criteria.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves the next HL7InQueue with a pending status.

methods.name: deleteHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes a specified HL7InQueue.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves an HL7InArchive entity.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InArchives filtered by message state, with optional max results.

methods.name: getHL7InArchivesToMigrate
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InArchives eligible for migration based on age and status.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by its UUID.

methods.name: deleteHL7InArchive
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InArchive entity.

methods.name: saveHL7InError
methods.description: Saves an HL7InError entity.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InError by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InError by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InErrors
methods.description: Retrieves all HL7InError entries.

methods.name: deleteHL7InError
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InError entity.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Clears the current session cache.
